This choice of words suggests that the narrative is not merely assembled but engineered with care. The vocabulary is described as "precise and technical," indicating a deliberate avoidance of ambiguity or florid language in favor of clarity and accuracy.

Syntactically, the prose is characterized by a "methodical" structure. The sentences are likely balanced and deliberate, mirroring the analytical nature of the content. This structural rigidity lends "gravitas" to the work, creating a tone that is serious, authoritative, and grounded. The syntax supports the diction by ensuring that each idea is presented with logical progression and stability, reinforcing the overall impression of a sturdy and well-constructed narrative.
